showIndex.description: Show the index as root folder. An index is a media source directory and is the parent of all its folders. By default only its subdirectories are listed

showCover.description: Show a cover thumbnail of the folder. The cover is the first media of the folder or of its first subfolder. A media whose file name ends with '_cover' before its extension is preferred

order.description: Initial folder order. It is overruled by the order of the page
